headline: Anthropic’s IPO roadshow sets proposed share terms alongside disclosed compute-financing exposure
summary: Anthropic’s November 10, 2026 roadshow announcement sets proposed terms for its IPO: 825 million Class A shares, including about 801.35 million offered by Anthropic and 23.65 million by existing holders, at an expected $70–$78 per share, with proposed Nasdaq ticker ANT. The registration statement is not yet effective and the offering is not complete. The company’s Oct. 26 preliminary S-1 reports $11.6 billion in Q2 2026 revenue and $1.0 billion in operating income, usage-based services at 80% of first-half revenue, and cloud marketplaces at 48%. It also describes multi-year take-or-pay compute obligations and conditional infrastructure financing. These issuer disclosures do not establish delivered or utilized compute, aggregate commitment totals, final offering terms, future revenue or completed public-market financing.
